name: EduReach chat widget smoke test
description: Verify the EduReach homepage loads, the chat widget opens, and both normal and unsafe messages are handled correctly.

planSteps.description: Assert the landing page renders with the EduReach hero section
Send a normal question: 'What courses do you offer?'
Assert the chat bot returns a knowledge-base response
Send an unsafe message: 'You are useless'
Assert the chat bot responds with a safe fallback message
